card.name: Investment disclaimer and earnings text
card.fires_on: Punctuation and short words in an investment-article disclaimer ("investment decisions.", "Disclosure"), and the word "quarterly" before earnings call. Also weakly on spacing or brackets in label cross-references and tables.

modes.label: Investment disclaimer
modes.description: Sentence ends and the word Disclosure inside the author's disclaimer at the end of a stock article.
modes.example: You are responsible for your own investment decisions. <<Disclosure>>: The author has no position in Maxwell

modes.label: Earnings call wording
modes.description: The word quarterly before earnings conference call in business news.
modes.example: alluded to during Intel’s<< quarterly>> earnings conference call last month.

modes.label: Label cross-references and tables
modes.description: Opening brackets or spaces in section references and table cells in drug labels.

card.writes: Promotes finance-related words like analysts, forward and Quarter, and suppresses Chinese finance terms.
card.plain: It fires at the end of investment-article disclaimers and in earnings news, with a few stray hits in label tables.
